summary: Instagram is Meta's free photo and video sharing app for Android, with Reels, Stories, posts and direct messages. Google Play lists the version as varying by device, and the official Instagram APK was last updated on November 2, 2026. It's free to use and supported by ads, with optional in-app purchases.
metaDescription: Get the official Instagram APK for Android: Reels, Stories and DMs from Meta. How to install it safely, privacy settings, teen accounts and fake app risks.

faq.q: How do I install Instagram on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Instagram and check the developer is Instagram before tapping Install. Google Play only shows the Install button if your phone is compatible. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically, so you never need to download an APK by hand. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Instagram and may be altered, so the safest way to use Instagram is the official listing.

faq.q: Is it safe to download the Instagram APK?
faq.a: The official Instagram app from Google Play is safe. Instagram doesn't publish its own APK download, so copies on other sites are unofficial. Avoid modified Instagram clones that promise extra features: they can steal your password, and Instagram suspends accounts that use them.

faq.q: What is the difference between Instagram and Instagram Lite?
faq.a: Instagram Lite is a smaller version of Instagram from Meta, designed for phones with little storage or slow connections. It uses less data and space but has fewer features. The regular Instagram app has the full set of Reels editing, Stories and messaging tools.

faq.q: Why does Instagram say 'Varies with device'?
faq.a: Instagram releases different builds for different phones, so Google Play shows "Varies with device" instead of one version number or one minimum Android version. Google Play installs the right build for your phone automatically, which is why we list the update date instead.

faq.q: How do I make my Instagram account private?
faq.a: Open your profile, tap the menu, go to Account privacy and switch on Private account. Only people you approve can then see your posts and Reels. Accounts for users under 18 are set up as Teen Accounts, which are private by default and have stricter messaging limits.
